name: soyl-cloud
//: The web app lives at the repo root and stays there (ADR-001). Workspaces exist for shared JS packages only; services/api is Python and is not a workspace member.

overrides: These pin transitive dependencies that Next bundles at versions with published high-severity advisories. npm's own suggested fix is next@9.3.3 — a downgrade of seven majors — so it is not a fix.
postcss: XSS via unescaped </style>, plus two sourceMappingURL path-traversal advisories. Next bundles 8.4.31; 8.5.x is the same major and the same API.
sharp: four inherited libvips CVEs. Used by Next only for image optimisation; 0.34 to 0.35 is a minor bump.

brace-expansion and js-yaml: DoS advisories reached through eslint tooling, so build-time only. Pinned anyway because a red badge nobody has triaged is indistinguishable from one nobody should act on.
Every one of these is removable once Next ships a release that carries the patched versions itself. Check on each Next bump rather than leaving them to ossify.
